title.value: AB 1313: prohibits postsecondary schools from withholding transcripts from students who owe a debt

citations.quote: California Attorney General Xavier Becerra and Assemblymember Luz Rivas (D-Arleta) today announced AB 1313, their bill to help mitigate the student debt crisis, was signed into law.
The bill prohibits postsecondary schools from withholding transcripts from students who owe a debt
